parallels.note: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

translations.web: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
translations.bsb: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.
translations.kjv: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
translations.asv: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; He hath smitten my life down to the ground: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.
